name: 艾玛·皮尔森
introduction: Emma was born on February 27, 2014. Since young age she was eager to perform, attended different theater classes, and took part in a few plays. At 6 years old she decided to start doing it more professionally, started taking acting classes at David Gray Studio in Los Angeles and signed with a talent agents in NYC. In less than a month, she got a co-star role in Blue Bloods TV show on CBS. After that she played a lead role in multiple short films, commercials and feature films and got invited to Sag-Aftra. In 2022 Emma co-starred in FBI: Most Wanted on CBS, played a lead role in an award winning short film Hedgehog, lead in Hairpiece, lead in feature film based on the children's book series Lucy and the Lake Monster and lead in feature horror Stay out Of the Basement. During the summer months of 2023 Emma is planning to film another feature where she is playing a lead role as well. In her free time Emma likes to play with her dog Mickey and her sister Alissa, she loves to travel and enjoys the outdoors. She also continues to improve her acting skills and is working with private coaches from NY and LA. Emma is bilingual, plays piano, does aerial silks, sings well, and knows British and Russian dialects. She loves to play comedy and her dream is to get a role in a comedy sitcom on Disney or Nickelodeon!
